title: Serverless Developer
description: A deep, project-based roadmap for Serverless Developer: Ship event-driven applications with Lambda, functions, queues, APIs, managed databases, observability, cost control, and security.

tree.name: Foundations and Role Context
tree.description: Understand what Serverless Developer work looks like, which problems it solves, and the baseline concepts needed before building. This section establishes the fundamental understanding and initial tooling setup.

resources.title: AWS Serverless with AWS Lambda, API Gateway & EventBridge | Full Course for Beginners (Digital Cloud Training)

children.name: Introduction to Serverless Computing
children.description: Explore the fundamental concepts, benefits, use cases, and common misconceptions of serverless architecture. Understand the paradigm shift from traditional server management, focusing on Function-as-a-Service (FaaS) and Backend-as-a-Service (BaaS).

children.name: Event-Driven Architecture Fundamentals
children.description: Learn the core principles of event-driven architectures, including events, producers, consumers, event sources, and common patterns like choreography and orchestration. Understand how events drive serverless applications.

children.name: Cloud Provider Fundamentals (AWS Focus)
children.description: Gain foundational knowledge of essential AWS services that underpin serverless development. This includes AWS account structure, IAM for permissions management, basic networking concepts with VPC, S3 for object storage, and core compute concepts like EC2 to contrast with FaaS.

resources.title: Introduction to AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM)

children.name: Development Environment & Core Tooling
children.description: Set up your local development environment for serverless. Understand essential command-line tools (AWS CLI), version control with Git and GitHub/GitLab, and an introduction to Infrastructure as Code (IaC) concepts relevant to serverless deployments.

children.name: Serverless Programming Language Basics
children.description: Understand the basics of common programming languages used in serverless, such as Node.js or Python, including asynchronous programming, dependency management, and local testing setup.

resources.title: Asynchronous JavaScript: From Callbacks to Async/Await

tree.name: Core Serverless Services & Implementation
tree.description: Build practical skills by implementing serverless solutions using key AWS services. Focus on serverless compute, API interfaces, event handling, and common data stores, laying the groundwork for complex architectures.

resources.title: AWS Tutorial 172 - AWS Lambda in Hindi | What is Serverless & How to Create Your First Function (Gaurav Sharma)

children.name: AWS Lambda Deep Dive
children.description: Master AWS Lambda functions: understanding runtimes, triggers, invocation types (synchronous/asynchronous), concurrency controls, cold starts, versions, aliases, environment variables, and best practices for function design and optimization.

children.name: API Gateway for Serverless APIs
children.description: Learn to build robust serverless APIs using Amazon API Gateway. Cover REST APIs, HTTP APIs, WebSockets, proxy integrations, custom domains, caching, and request/response mapping.

resources.title: Building an API Gateway REST API with Lambda Proxy Integration

children.name: Authentication and Authorization for APIs
children.description: Implement secure access for serverless APIs. Learn about API Gateway authorizers (IAM, Lambda Custom Authorizers, Cognito User Pools), token-based authentication (JWT, OAuth), and basic identity management with Amazon Cognito.

resources.title: Control access to a REST API using IAM permissions
Protecting APIs with Amazon Cognito and API Gateway

children.name: Serverless Data Persistence & Caching
children.description: Implement data persistence using serverless-friendly databases and caching mechanisms. Focus on Amazon DynamoDB (data modeling, access patterns, transactions, global tables), S3 for object storage, static content hosting, and event sources. Introduction to Aurora Serverless and caching strategies.

children.name: Event Messaging and Queuing Services
children.description: Integrate asynchronous processing and communication using serverless messaging services. Cover Amazon SQS for message queues (standard/FIFO, dead-letter queues), SNS for publish/subscribe patterns, and EventBridge for intelligent event routing and event bus integration.

resources.title: Building event-driven architectures with Amazon EventBridge
Decoupling Microservices with SQS and SNS

children.name: Infrastructure as Code (IaC) & Deployment
children.description: Learn to define, deploy, and manage serverless applications using Infrastructure as Code. Focus on tools like AWS SAM, Serverless Framework, or AWS CDK for robust, repeatable deployments and understanding underlying CloudFormation principles.

resources.title: AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM) Developer Guide
Introduction to AWS CDK for Serverless

children.name: Local Development and Testing Serverless Applications
children.description: Implement effective testing strategies for serverless applications, including unit tests, integration tests, end-to-end testing, and local simulation techniques with tools like SAM CLI local. Understand mocking, dependency injection, and test environments.

tree.name: Production Readiness and Advanced Patterns
tree.description: Prepare serverless applications for production with best practices in observability, security, cost management, and advanced architectural patterns. Move beyond basic implementations to build resilient, scalable, and maintainable systems.

resources.title: Serverless Node.js Tutorial - Neon Serverless Postgres, AWS Lambda, Next.js, Vercel (freeCodeCamp.org)

children.name: Observability and Monitoring
children.description: Implement comprehensive monitoring, logging, and tracing for serverless applications using CloudWatch Logs (structured logging, log groups), CloudWatch Metrics (custom metrics, alarms, anomaly detection), and AWS X-Ray for distributed tracing across services. Learn to set up custom dashboards and real-time operational insights.

resources.title: Using AWS X-Ray with AWS Lambda

children.name: Serverless Security Best Practices
children.description: Deepen your understanding of security for serverless workloads: managing IAM roles and policies with least privilege, securing API endpoints with WAF, data encryption at rest and in transit (KMS), input validation, secret management with AWS Secrets Manager and Parameter Store, and adherence to the AWS Well-Architected Framework Security Pillar.

children.name: Cost Optimization for Serverless
children.description: Learn strategies for minimizing costs in serverless architectures. Understand detailed billing models for Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, and other services. Implement right-sizing, provisioned concurrency, S3 lifecycle policies, and continuous monitoring for cost control using AWS Cost Explorer and Budgets.

resources.title: Optimizing AWS Lambda cost and performance

children.name: Advanced Serverless Architecture Patterns
children.description: Explore complex serverless patterns to build robust and scalable systems. Includes state machines with AWS Step Functions, event stream processing with Kinesis, serverless containers with AWS Fargate and Lambda container images, and patterns for idempotency and error handling.

resources.title: Serverless Architectural Patterns and Best Practices

children.name: Real-time Stream Processing with Serverless
children.description: Learn to build real-time data processing pipelines using serverless services. Focus on Amazon Kinesis Data Streams and Kinesis Firehose for ingestion and processing, integrated with AWS Lambda for transformation and analysis.

resources.title: Processing streaming data with AWS Lambda

children.name: Serverless Containers (Lambda Container Images & Fargate)
children.description: Understand how to leverage containerization within a serverless paradigm. Explore AWS Lambda container images for larger dependencies or custom runtimes and AWS Fargate for running containers without managing servers for long-running or batch workloads.

children.name: CI/CD for Serverless Applications
children.description: Set up automated continuous integration and continuous deployment pipelines for serverless projects using services like AWS CodePipeline, GitHub Actions, or GitLab CI, integrated with SAM or Serverless Framework for automated testing and deployment strategies (e.g., canary deployments, blue/green).

resources.title: Building a CI/CD pipeline for serverless applications using AWS SAM and AWS CodePipeline

children.name: Full-Stack Serverless & Frontend Integration
children.description: Learn to integrate serverless backends with modern frontend applications. Cover static site hosting with S3/CloudFront, API consumption patterns, integrating with AWS Amplify for simplified frontend development, and using Lambda@Edge for content delivery at the edge.

tree.name: Portfolio and Career Readiness
tree.description: Turn your Serverless Developer learning into proof: case studies, GitHub artifacts, demos, interview stories, and clear role positioning. This section focuses on showcasing your skills and preparing for a career.

children.name: Case Study & Project Documentation
children.description: Learn to articulate your serverless projects effectively through detailed case studies. Document problem statements, architectural decisions, implementation details, challenges overcome, and achieved outcomes, ready for review by potential employers or collaborators.

resources.title: Writing Effective Documentation for Your Projects

children.name: Capstone Project: End-to-End Serverless Application
children.description: Build a comprehensive, portfolio-grade serverless application. Incorporate multiple services (Lambda, API Gateway, DynamoDB, SQS/SNS, EventBridge, Step Functions, S3/CloudFront), CI/CD, observability, and security best practices. Focus on a real-world use case to demonstrate full-stack serverless capabilities and problem-solving skills.

children.name: Interview Preparation & Serverless Concepts
children.description: Prepare for technical interviews by reviewing common serverless questions, architectural design challenges, and practical problem-solving scenarios. Focus on explaining key concepts, trade-offs, and best practices in serverless development.

resources.title: AWS Lambda Interview Questions and Answers
